theme: H-912 registration, excavation ranges and the Belcher fish-area object frame

authors.name: GPT-6 family; exact model identifier not exposed

question: Does the primary excavation record link H-912 or related registered tablets to a container, fish remains or an administrative allotment?
outcome: Vats confirms 8650c in a four-tablet group from Mound F, Trench IV, squares H12/21 and I12/1. The primary depth is 4–7 feet below surface; the export's −5.5 feet equals the midpoint and has no inspected primary point-measurement source. Three months of recovery, conflicting Stratum III and IV labels and individual suffixes prevent treating 8650 as a closed deposit. Fourteen suffix records, twelve broader associations and sixteen export-prefix candidates are retained. H-302's F.C. 3864, excavation 8650c and accession ASI 63.11.94 are separated; the 8650c448 reference shared by H-912 and H-1191 remains unresolved. Belcher's 1990 Mound E plan supplies fourteen unique object joins on 21 faces, but no object-to-fish-lot correspondence. No container, contents or allotment association for H-912 was found in the inspected sources.
challenge: Image-only Vats scans, a misindexed printed page, merged catalogue and registration strings, conflicting stratum labels, an unavailable CISI3.1 view and a failed RMRL PDF retrieval.
remedy: Used newly acquired OCR only to locate candidates, inspected complete rendered primary pages, preserved ranges and source conflicts, retained each registration and observational grade, separated plan-area location from fish-lot association, and performed no physical merges or real confirmation reads.
retry_when: Acquire the CISI 3.1 H-1191 view or original registration records; resolve the 8650 series' individual deposit and stratum assignments; recover the H90 plan objects' individual lots; or obtain a registered tablet-to-container or allotment link with independently measured contents and quantity. A new split or a shared mound does not supply the missing physical relation.
